description: Ministry of Labour - The Collective Agreement between Chilaw Plantations Limited Vs. Ceylon Estate Staffs Union (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a private company (Chilaw Plantations Limited) and a trade union (Ceylon Estate Staffs Union) under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, conditions, and dispute resolution mechanisms. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the official publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks for employment relationships, consistent with Type 5 classification for legal framework and regulatory matters.
